description: Roper Technologies, Inc. is a diversified technology company with a proven, long-term, successful track record of compounding cash flow and increasing shareholder value, operating market leading businesses that design and develop vertical software and technology enabled products for a variety of defensible niche markets, and it pursues consistent and sustainable growth in revenue, earnings and cash flow by enabling continuous improvement in the operating performance of its businesses and by acquiring businesses that offer high value-added software, services, technology-enabled products and solutions that it believes are capable of realizing growth while maintaining high margins, competing in many defensible niche markets where it believes it is the market leader or a competitive alternative to the market leader in most of them, and in the last three years it has deployed approximately $8,960 of capital toward acquisitions. Its Application Software segment had net revenues of $4,483.0 for the year ended December 31, 2025, representing 56.7 percent of its total net revenues, and includes businesses such as Aderant, providing comprehensive management software and AI-enabled solutions for law and other professional services firms, and CentralReach, providing SaaS and AI-enabled solutions enabling the workflow and administration of ABA therapy for autism spectrum disorders.
